paragraphs.text: More Than Meets the Eye is a keyword ability introduced in the Universes Beyond cross-over Transformers set, named after the tagline of the franchise. It allows players to cast the backside of a double-faced card for an alternate cost .

More Than Meets the Eye is a way to combine modal double-faced cards with transforming double-faced cards . It is an alternative cost that lets the caster cast the converted side. A keyword was needed, because the rules couldn't handle both.

All cards with More Than Meets the Eye use convert as a concession to the trademark. Mark Rosewater has stated that the mechanic could be explored under a different name in the future and could use "transformed" or "transform".

New double-faced cards that are both modal and capable of transforming were printed in Marvel's Spider-Man . This suggests that More Than Meets the Eye is conceptually obsolete. The Transformers cards have not received errata to use this new formatting in place of More Than Meets the Eye.

Starscream, Power Hungry Legendary Artifact Creature — Robot More Than Meets the Eye (You may cast this card converted for ) Flying Whenever you draw a card, if you're the monarch, target opponent loses 2 life. Whenever one or more creatures deal combat damage to you, convert Starscream. 2/3
